description:
Compare your taste with another user — compatibility score, shared and divergent notes/accords/families, and an optional AI overview. Free for any signed-in account; the AI overview needs Pro and is left out otherwise.

See also: `user_taste_public` for a user's top preferences · `user_taste_summary` for your own summary.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

target_user_id.description: User ID to compare your taste with

with_overview.description: Include the AI overview (Pro only; left out for free accounts)

name: user_taste_compare
